label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is obj array containing bar (decoded Referer header) which is attacker-controlled. Data flow: request.getHeader("Referer") → param → URLDecoder.decode → doSomething (switchTarget='C' assigns param to bar) → obj[0]=bar → printf writes obj to response. No HTML encoding applied to bar before writing to response. X-XSS-Protection disabled confirms intent.

evidence.note: User input from Referer header flows through param, decoded, assigned to bar via switch('C'), placed in obj array, and written unsanitized to response via printf
doSomething switch assigns param to bar when switchTarget equals 'C' (always true)
